title: Re-checked request input (v0.5, D33 amendment 2026-10-29)
description: Input of the request-recheck vectors: the evaluations schild ran for one HTTP request, in order (e.g. the site block's schild, then schild in handle_errors after the URI changed). The result is {requests, rechecked, outcome, detection, path, checked_paths, rules, score} (contract/monitoring.Recheck): the request counts once; outcome is the last evaluation's when it stopped the request, else would_block when any evaluation was would_block, else passed; only the last evaluation may stop the request (a stop ends it), anything else is `schema`. Never sent anywhere.

path.description: The path this evaluation inspected (redacted as the event path, no query).

detection.description: The WAF reached its blocking decision (enforced or observed).
